_comment: Animation takes for the anime cast (Tools/dai/anime). Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Fall, Land, Duel, Swim and Tread are solved on the cast skeleton by Tools/dai/anime/gait.py / build.py (biomechanical foot planting and leg IK); the gestures below are CC0 Quaternius takes retargeted onto the shared anime skeleton, with their legs re-solved so the feet stay planted. 'take' = source action name (after the last '|'); optional 'frames' [first, last], 'speed' (playback multiplier) and 'arm_drop' (degrees: the astronaut's bulky suit holds the arms away from the body). The cast itself is modelled by the project's own generator (Tools/dai/anime/atelier) - no base model is registered by default. 'anime_models': artist-made character models (VRM / glTF / FBX humanoids) dropped in Tools/thirdparty/<pack>/<asset>/ with a SOURCE.txt: {key: {file, female, height (crown height in metres)}}. 'cast_models': {cast slot id or design key: anime_models key} - which slot each artist model replaces. See Docs/CHARACTER_MODELS.md.
